job_spec.purpose: redesign-ds 2026-10-09 (OWNER: structural alternatives, no cycle/area limit): SYSTOLIC VM bank-group tile (rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_bgq_sys.sv, NSTG=2, outline contract_vmh_t): ONE request bus (pin reg -> N..S past every bank row -> f_*) and ONE AND-OR read-return bus moving in lockstep with it (upstream r_* -> each bank ORs its due slot -> o_*); removes the NG=4 stage-A copies, the separate forward bundle and the central 32:1 read select (~13k -> ~2.2k vertical nets). Every vm_bgq/bgh/bg route died in GRT (markers at the 20000 cap; best 1,184). Variant b: 1.5x taller outline 253.794 x 750.06 (contract_vmh_t; row channels 61.56 -> 98.6 um pitch) and a mid-tile bus register (NSTG 2): area + margin.
